nom: Urban Hydration Aloe Vera Leaf Face & Body Bar Soap

avis.texte: As someone with psoriasis too easily triggered by colder weather (I swear my body knows the exact date fall starts), this soap - and their whole line of products - is something I never want to be without. Between the cold, dry air and frequent hand washing, the skin on my poor hands flares up and doesnt settle down until May. After almost of year of waiting and using Urban Hydration's other products, this bar soap FINALLY got stocked. Immediately ordered six bars because I knew how amazing their other aloe products were, and this bar did not disappoint. Non-drying, non-irritating, barely has a scent, rinses off cleanely without completely stripping every bit of your skin's protective barrier. My cuticles are less dry and ragged. Even my nails do better with this soap. I wish Ulta sold the line in our local stores. I'd drive to each one and buy all the bars of soap I could get! But seriously…if you, a family member, or friend deal with eczema, psoriasis, or have dry or easily irritated skin as a side effect of medication or other medical condition, please let them know about this soap and skin lotion in the same aloe line. If you read this, Ulta - PLEASE start selling in this multipacks so those of us who don't wish to ever be without this wonder soap will have an easy way to order a whole case at a time.
This soap is amazing my sons face was so bad and omg how this soap did miracles in one week u see a big difference
I use this soap to shave. it leaves my skin super soft and helps get a close shave!

This bar soap is very gentle. I love how it has a bumpy texture, feels nice gliding over your body and face! The bar is nice and sturdy didn't "melt" away like other glycerin style soaps. Contains no paragons, silicones, sulfates or phthalates. Gentle enough for any skin type. Rinses easy and you feel clean and fresh
This soap is super gentle and did not cause any irritation or sensitivities. It's very mild and the smell is mild and nice.
This soap smells nice and for a glycerin soap has held up well to being wet. Some glycerin soaps dissolve quickly after using. I did not like the nubs on one side of the bar.

I can not lie, I really just do not know with this soap. The nubs on one side of the bar just make it even more uncomfortable to me. My skin feels dry and like this soap just sucked all the moisture right out of me.

OMG Guys this is by far one of my new favorite lines of products. I use UH Shea lotion and I love it, so I decided to try out he face soap...I love it. I am usually very skeptical about face products since I have extremely sensitive skin and I have to be very careful with the products I use. This Aloe Vera face soap is super clean, it vegan, paraben and sulfate free. It doesn't leave a nasty soap film on your skin, my skin feel smooth and moisturized. It smells amazing with hints of coconut and aloe, but it's not too aggressive to cause break-outs. I love that the bar has bumps and act as a built-in massager. It really makes my skin feel nourished and soft.

I love using this face and body soap so much! The coconut oil and aloe vera keeps my skin soft and smooth and super hydrated! Excellent smell ! I use it everyday in the shower and to wash my face. Highly recommended.

This face and body soap is perfect for my eczema. I get eczema really bad on my hands and arms This soap helps keep my skin moisturized and have noticed my eczema flare ups have lessen in occurrence and severity.

This urban hydration soap bar is perfect to have in the shower. It can be used on your face and body. The aloe vera moisturizes my skin really well and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I love that it is clean beauty and has no parabens, no silicones, no phthalates, and no sulfates!

I got this uh aloe Vera face & body bar soap hopeful for a great product and that's just what I got. I have very sensitive skin and a lot of facial care items make my face breakout in a rash. This aloe Vera bar though works wonderfully and did not irritate my skin at all.

The aloe vera soap and body bar has really made a difference in my skin. It smells great and leaves my skin feeling soft and smooth. It's also helped reduce the appearance of any blemishes and dark spots. It's thin and easy to wash of but gives a great lathering effect. Did I mention I love the smell? This soap has a clean fresh smell with a hint of aloe. I highly recommend it for all skin types. My entire family uses it and they love the way it makes their skin feel.
This has been perfect around my husbands beard as i has provided lots of cleansing and moisture

I wanted to try this soap for my excema prone skin. It worked well and was easy to get a lather from. It left my skin feeling soft after rinsing unlike others that can leave you dry. I am also happy to report that my sensitive skin did not have any issue!
Great soap! Love the smell, leaves your skin feeling smooth and soft, no leftover residue or soap "scum" feeling.

This bar of soap really wowed me! It is so clean fresh scent. I love the texture and how it cleans super deep! It leaves my skin feeling amazing and glowing! It isn't drying - the coconut oil really leaves my skin feeling great!

I love using the UH Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap, it is so soothing and feels great on my skin. The price is comparable with other likeminded soaps so I feel really good about this. It made my sensitive skin feel so good and my face was so soft after using.
This little cube of soap is fantastic! I adore the little massage nubs. I haven't been able to figure out what it smells like though. The scent doesn't last long.
The soap smells good. It makes your skin soft and does not dry out.

Rarely do you find a bar soap that can be used on both your face and body. When you have sensitive skin, it makes it even harder to find a bar soap. I am so excited that we found this amazing soap. My daughter deals with sensitive skin and eczema, so I was eager to let her try it, as well. She was so incredibly excited that we finally found a soap that is effective, makes her skin glow, and doesn't irritate it. I, too, have sensitive skin and I was incredibly pleased with the results. My skin didn't break out or develop any type of rash. Additionally, it felt softer, smoother, and it definitely had a nice glow to it after just one use. It's amazing how long one bar of soap can last! I highly recommend this to anyone and everyone with all different types of skin. You won't be disappointed!

The UH Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap has been great for my skin! It has left my skin feeling smooth and clean. I'll definitely be adding this product to my regimen. No funny smell and the consistency is nice. Works great!

It pays to follow directions. I assumed that the nubs on soap were for massaging and applied it directly on my face to wash it and it left my face feeling really sticky and unpleasant during the wash. The next time, I lathered the soap on my hands and applied the lather on my face and it was perfection. It left my skin feeling moisturized and not sticky. The only improvement I would make would be to make the scent a bit stronger because it smells a lot better in the package than during use.

Well first off, who doesn't love a company that gives back?! Building fresh water wells, that was enough for me to want to try this! The scent is nice and light, not overwhelming at all. It's nice and gentle on my face and cleans well, it didn't leave my skin feeling dry at all. I was quite impressed with the overall product and company.
This soap works wonderfully. It doesn't leave any type of residue and is non drying. It feels great on my skin and leaves my skin feeling refreshed, moisturized and most importantly clean!

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling absolutely amazing!
avis.texte: As soon as I opened the packaging, I immediately noticed the light minty scent and it smells absolutely amazing! I have been using this face and body soap for the past few days and I am super impressed! I have dry skin and this soap is a life saver! My skin feels so soft and hydrated! I have tried an array of other soaps which only left my skin feeling more dried out. This soap leaves my skin feeling amazing! The bar itself lathers up great and the rinses well leaving no soap residue on your skin. The bar has bumps on it which feels great on your skin! It is like you're getting a gentle massage all while cleaning your skin! I can't wait to see what this soap will do for my skin with continued use of this product! I also love that there are no harsh chemicals in this soap and that it is made with Aloe and Coconut Oil. This will now be my new brand of soap for my whole family. If you are looking for a soap that leaves your skin not only clean but feeling incredible, I definitely recommend this one by Urban Hydration!

I love the mild scent of this body bar and the way it goes onto the skin. It seems to clean the skin very very well. I have combination skin, it left my skin very grippy feeling and dried me out pretty good. This might not happen to everyone so I would certainly give it a try. It's just simply not for my skin type

Oh my gosh I love this soap. In general, I think most bar soaps are too fragranced or drying. This one is the perfect mix of a fresh clean hint of scent + very hydrating. I will definitely be buying more and replace all of my old soaps with it. Husband loves it too so definitely good for both genders.

I bought Urban Hydration - UH Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap and I must say it's my new favorite product. I was afraid it was going to dry my skin but it definitely didn't at all. I love the shape of the bar. It massaged and also didn't get slimmy in the shower. The scent is perfect and I felt clean.

Got this last week and love it! It makes my face feel great and smells awesome as well. Love the texture of how it's made! On top of it it's a women owned business and every purchase helps build fresh water wells in Kenya! So cool! Definitely buy!

I love this soap and body bar it has has rounded massage bumps on it which is nice nice the smell is great super refreshing and clean. I would highly recommend to everyoneI would highly recommend to everyone

Urban Hydration is on point, with this aloe vera face and body bar! It smells so good! It left my skin feeling clean, fresh, and hydrated! My whole family loves it, and that's a rarity! I highly recommend this body bar soap!
Im in love with this soap it smells great and lathers great! It makes my skin feel refreshing snd soft and i love it.

I was surprised at how gentle the Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap was on my skin, especially my face. My facial skin has become sensitive and I had no irritation with is bar soap at all. I also really love the fragrance, it's a light and clean scent. It's also very easy to hold and sit down without sliding because of the raised area of the soap.

I received and tried my UH Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap.It lathers well and makes my face and body feel clean and refreshing.It has aloe Vera which is very effective in moisturizing skin without leaving a greasy feel.I would recommend it to my friends and family.

I've been using the Urban Hydration aloe Vera bar for some weeks now, and I really like it. I've used it more so in the shower for my body than my face, and I've noticed my skin responds well to it. Smells great. And the ingredients are clean.

I loved the soft, minty scent of this face and body bar! The fact that it was clear meant I knew for certain there were no artificial colors. This lathered really nicely and left my skin feeling clean and moisturized.
Great soap, love the smell. It's a clear bar of soap and has grooved top for better scrubbing while using. Love this soap leaves me feeling fresh and clean all day long! A great find!

I feel good about the ingredients in this soap! It does a good job cleansing makeup off and doesn't seem to leave any residue. I follow with a natural moisturizer and my skin is pretty soft & happy :)

Super clean and fresh bar - love the little nubs for it not getting super slippery and to rub on skin. Smells nice but really it's a fresh and almost unscented smell. Feels clean but doesn't make you feel squeaky or dried out, which is great as colorado is such a dry place. Love it.

I like this soap so far. It's free of any dyes and doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped. It smells nice, like essential oil not artificial fragrance. I really like the shape of it. Initially I thought it was supposed to be massaging, but I don't lather my body with the soap itself, so I thought it was kind of useless. But then I realized the shape of it allows the bar to dry without it sitting in a pool of water, GENIUS!

I'm not used to using bar soap but I found this one to be very nice. I like the textured side and it seemed to clean well. It creates a good, soft lather and rinses easily. It didn't overly dry my skin (though I still lotion after use). The smell is very natural, without a perfume. And assuming the packaging is correct, it's low-waste. :)

This is the first time I have tried a soap with aloe in it and I like it so far. My complexion has stayed clear and smooth. I use it daily on my face and appreciate the lack of strong smell. I also like the ridges on it- it almost feels like a small facial massage. I have used it for about 2 weeks now and am enjoying it!

This is a nice bar of soap. It's not as big as the bars of soap I use daily, but it still does the job. The "lego" style side is comfortable for massaging. It has a mild scent and is rather nice. I like the messaging the brand has for giving a gallon of water; I love companies devoted to sustainability. Great idea.

My family and I have been using UH Aloe Vera Face and Body Bar Soap for about a month and we love it! I absolutely love that it is Silicone, Paraben, Polybead and Sulfate free which is important in products my family uses. I also love the scent as well as the massaging bumps. My face and body feels soft and fresh after each use. It's also great that its made for several different skin types. I look forward to trying other products from this line. Highly recommended

My skin tends to be sensitive so I was a little reluctant to use this on my face, but it left my skin moisturized and smooth. I had no reaction the next day either. The bar smells AMAZING!! Your skin feels so fresh and clean after showering with this Aloe Vera bar.

I really like the smell of this. The scent is mild and clean and ever so lightly green-- likely from the aloe but it almost smells like a very subtle mint. Its a really soothing scent. I like that the bar is dye free with no unnecessary colors or strong perfumes. I have used it on my face and it is okay-- not my favorite, but in a pinch it will do-- it isn't harsh at all so that is great. Where this shines is a s a body soap -- the shape makes for a great massage as you are lathering up. The bar also does not melt quickly so overall it is a winner for me.
I really enjoyed using this face and body bar soap. It has a subtle minty scent, leaves your skin feeling fresh and clean. After using my skin feels soft and hydrated throughout the day.

I really did not have any expectations from this soap but I was pleasantly surprised! It lathers nicely and has a nice light scent. My regular soap seems to be so drying and requires me to apply body lotion immediately after my shower. My skin was not dry at all after using this thanks to the moisturizing aloe. I like that it does not have silicone and some of those other common questionable ingredients. Lastly, this company is women owned and donates for every product sold. They are helping third world countries have fresh water....what's not to love about that awesomeness!!

Love this soap. It has a very light and refreshing scent. It lathers well in the shower. Rinses easily and doesn't leave any residue. My skin feels soft and moisturized after using it. I would recommend this soap!

This urban hydration bright & balanced aloe Vera face and body soap smells and feels so good on my skin. I love that it moisturizes while cleaning the body and hands. Doesn't leave any my skin feeling greasy. I love how it has the teeth in it to help wash your body and leave it feeling clean.

I have sensitive skin so I have to be careful with the soap I pick up and this was one of the smoothest and well made soaps I've ever seen. It smells amazing and doesn't aggerate my skin at all. I recently got burned when cooking and put a little soap on it and it instantly gave relief. It's a multipurpose soap and it's at a price you can afford and from a brand you can trust.
I received the UH Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap a couple of weeks ago and it working to help with my acne.

Urban Hydration's Bright & Balanced Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar has these distinct bumps that feel really good on your skin as the bar glides across it! I love the scent on this soap. It leaves my skin feeling smooth, referenced It's ideal for sensitive skin, too! I would recommend this to anyone looking for a new gentle cleanser with a fresh scent.

I got this for my daughter once I noticed her skin started to break out a little easier, she enjoys when the soap is new the raised bumps on it. The scent is not too strong to where it bothers her, for now I am letting her use it for face only to see if it helps out.

Aloe is fantastic for dry, sensitive, and inflamed skin. I learned this after using a sample of a different product, so this Aloe face and body bar seemed perfect for my dry skin and rosacea prone face. I was honestly blown away by how much I love this beautifully simple bar of soap! It creates the most luscious, silky lather that feels like a spa treatment even if I'm doing a quick face wash before bed. My rosacea was starting to flare when I got the Aloe soap, and I tend to have lots of redness, bumps, and even deep cysts that take a long, painful while to heal. Not this time! Seriously, I thought I was headed for a few weeks of painful struggle to get my skin calmed. The only thing I changed about my routine was the Aloe bar, and the redness, bumps and that ugly cyst near my nose that I could see forming have all calmed down within a few days. My skin is so soft, too! I'm not saying it's magic and my face is perfect now, but I am saying that it stopped the acute inflammation that was making my face miserable. My face feels good, and I'm confident this Aloe bar will continue to help the healing process. And I love it for body wash as well. It is really moisturizing and has helped all those trouble dry spots. The silky lather is amazing for shaving! It creates a lather that all those shaving gels wish they could be. I get a really close, comfortable shave even with a slightly dull razor that I should have tossed last week. Because the Aloe bar works so well for face, body, a

I love how much thought went into this soap. Even the little knobs on the bottom that prevent it from sitting in water are a nice touch! As for the soap itself, I love it! It has a pleasant smell, and lathers well. My skin feels hydrated and clean after use. It rinses well and I'm left feeling fresh, moisturized, and clean. I would definitely recommend this soap to my family and friends. I love that I know what's in it and it does a great job.

The UH Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap is so gentle on the skin that it can be used in the face and the entire body, is rare when a soap can be used like that. The scent is great because is very mild, not overpowering at all, but it does leave a nice smell on your skin that makes you feel clean. The bumps are great because they act as a massager, love to use that side on my legs and neck. The aloe vera extract and the coconut oil moisturizes the skin, I've noticed that my skin feels softer and alive since using this product. I must mentioned that for some reason I live that this soap is clear. No greasy feeling at all after using it, I honestly love this, a soap should not make you feel like that but in this case is the opposite, great feeling after each use. Great for people with eczema, acne, psoriasis, etc. Of course one of the things why this product caught my attention is because is free of silicone, paraben , polybead and sulfate, less chemicals on things we use for our body are way better for it, and because of this I feel great knowing the kids can use it too. After using this product for weeks I for sure will keep buying it!

avis.titre: Aloe Vera face and body bar soap
avis.texte: The Urban Hydration Aloe Vera Face and body bar soap is great. It lathers nicely and has a wonderful scent to it. The soap is also good to use on your face. It leaves it feeling moisturized and not greasy or dried out. I love how this product is an all in one. It can be used on your face as well as your entire body. Such a great product that leaves your skin feeling so good.

I really like this face and body soap. It's has an amazing scent that lasts a long time on my skin. It has the massage aspect that makes it extra relaxing. It's very moisturizing and pretty fun to use.

avis.titre: Love this soap for my face
avis.texte: I've been using this soap for 2 weeks now. I've noticed that my face is less shiny and oily. It's really a great deep cleaning soap. My face isn't dry at all and normally when the weather changes here in the Midwest my face gets very dry. This bar of soap will really last a long time. After 2 weeks it still looks like new.

Soap with aloe vera is great for sensitive skin and Urban Hydration knows how to "get it right." It's the perfect soap for both body and face because it contains no parabens, silicones or sulfates. It has a pleasant, non-greasy feel and the little "bumps" in the soap make it easy to hold.

I have been using this bar soap for my body and I really like it, my skin feels very soft and smooth afterward. I never feel dry after my shower like some soaps, this one actually hydrates and keeps my skin soft and I don't put lotion on after either. Also, it just has a faint scent which I like.

avis.titre: Great soap for people who don't like strong scents
avis.texte: The soap lathers well, rinses well, and leaves almost no scent. I wash my hands often and they don't get dried out with this soap. It also doesn't leave a big soapy mess next to my sink. The little bumps on the soap are great for small sinks that don't have room for a soap dish.
This was a great soap that had a mild scent and was good for my skin. It was moisturizing and cleansing without leaving a residue. I used it for face and body and would recommend it to others.

My kids ended up using my soap bar because they think it looks neat. One side has bumps, which is great for a few reasons. It doesn't get soggy on the counter, it is easier to hold, and my kids think it is some sort of soap toy. I love aloe vera, and this soap is great for sensitive skin. My whole family can use it, and it has a light scent. Overall, I would recommend for anyone, even those with sensitive skin.

I have extremely dry skin so I am always on the lookout for products that don't make the problem worse. The aloe drew me to this soap and it did not disappoint! I love the bumpy side for massage and so the soap can dry out without getting soggy on the bottom. All around great soap and no heavy scent!

Urban Hydration Bright & Balanced Aloe Vera Leaf Face & Body bar soap is amazing. I love that it is Paraben, Silicone and sulfate-free! The coconut oil is great at cleansing your face and body without using harsh chemicals. This skin cleanser helps soften and hydrate my skin while leaving it feeling refreshed and exfoliated. I also love the added aspect of having Aloe Vera included in the soap.

This Aloe Vera face and body bar works great! It smells amazing and leaves my skin soft, clean and refreshed. I love that I can use it on my body and it's gentle enough for my face. The natural in are a plus! I like the ridges on one side making it massage like while cleaning my back and shoulders. It's not greasy and doesn't leave a residue on my skin. I love how great my skin looks!
I really like this bar of soap. It leaves my body feeling soft and smooth. I'm a big fan of Aloe Vera and this did not disappoint.

This soap was great. I loved the knobbly little massage bumps. They were great for showering and giving that extra clean feel. I did not like the scent. It was not herbal or fresh. It was just...Soapy, like glycerine. it lathered really well and left my skin very squeaky clean. I suppose that should not have been too squeaky as this is supposed to be a hydrating soap, what with the Aloe Vera and all. I'm probably not going to buy this back because of that over drying rather than moisturizing finish. But overall, I do like the soap for the massaging nodes.
This face and body bar is so convenient. I love how it laters up and how it feels on both my face and body. It had a wonderful smell!

This is a nice bar soap! I like that it can be used both for the face and body. It has ridges molded into the soap for better cleaning. The soap actually lathers up nicely. My skin felt hydrated and clean afterwards.

I started using the Aloe Vera Face and body soap on my face. I have several dark spots on my face due to acne and heard that aloe was the best thing to use to get rid of the spot, I've been washing my face with the soap every morning and night for three days now, my skin feel softer and seems to have a brighter complexion, I can't write to see how the dark spots will look in two weeks, will continue to use.

I love this bar for my face. The lather is quick and nice. It goes on my face and rinses clean. I usually have a shiny, oily face within an hour. Thanks to this soap I can get through half the day. The must needed extra bonus is it does not dry out my face or body. I am a hard one with an oily face and eczema on my hands and arms, but this soap stands up to them both.

I like the design of the soap which isn't a huge reason to buy soap. However, I like that it is clear and that one side is textured. The smell is decent and kind of strong but it is no more powerful than other soaps. I like that the box shares the company gives back to communities.

avis.titre: Urban Hydration Face & Body Bar Soap!
avis.texte: The Urban Hydration Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap is a sulfate-free, coconut oil derived bar soap which cleanses my face and body without the harsh chemicals. This gentle skin cleansing soap with added bumps on the surface gently massage my skin, and help soften and hydrate my dry, dull skin while promoting circulation and skin regeneration. I love to use this soap at all times since I know it is free of Silicone, Parabens, Polybeads and is Sulfate free too and is safe for all skin types including oily, psoriasis prone as well as eczema prone skin too. Also, I know that this amazing soap is safe for my entire family. Also, this soap is made of Aloe Vera, which helps detox skin to fight acne. I have already recommended the Urban Hydration Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap to many of my friends and family and several of them have already purchased and used it and just love using this safe and clean soap which doesn't dry out their skin or leave a residue, as well as it is free of Silicone, Parabens, Polybeads and Sulfates, which is why everyone including me, love to use this amazing soap daily.

I have only used it once so far, love the fragrance and how clean it feels. It made my face dry out but I do have dry skin overall anyways. I will continue to use for a week and see how it goes. It seems natural to me
This is a nice soap and I like that it has exfoliating ridges. Smell is light and clean.

This soap bar is clean and uses aloe which is super wonderful and moisturizing. I love soaps that you can use for both body and face but I normally find them to be too drying on my face. This one did not have that issue! It left me feeling clean and refreshed but not overly dry
The Urban Hydration - UH Aloe Vera Face & Body Bar Soap left my skin glowing and so soft. It also smells so good.

I used this on my face and body after a workout. I don't mind the soap, but the shape is a bit odd to me. There are studs on it like a LEGO that I don't quite understand. So, I could only lather on on side. The lather also wasn't the best. Not bad, but not remarkable.

I use bar soap when washing my face in the shower. This soap performed just as well as the dermatologist brand that I had been using. My skin is sensitive and it left my skin feeling clean and not irritated.

Urban Hydration Aloe Vera face & body soap is so good. My skin looks and feels amazing. This is a clean based product to get maximum results. I have always struggled with my skin breaking out. And not just my face. So this is the best soap I have tried. I can't get over the difference on my body. I have clear soft skin now. I definitely will continue using Urban Hydration Soap for sure.

This soap is great for me. I've got sensitive skin and also live in a dry climate so washing my hands, I just feel like I'm constantly making my hands cracked. This soap helps my son feel soft without feeling greasy. I would recommend it.

I love that this face and body bar is so gentle on my skin. I have sensitive skin and have had no issues with this soap at all. It leaves my skin soft and very hydrated. The ingredient list is perfect and it doesn't have any fillers like so many other brands.

I have really enjoyed the Urban Hydration Aloe Vera Face and Body bar soap. The bar itself is textured and the smell is just right...not too much. I love that my face feels hydrated after washing instead of tight and dry. Would definitely recommend this bar soap for daily use and face and body since it is so gentle on the skin.
